name: savvy-progress
description: Live view of every helper at work: the main loop's model and phase, subagents, teammates, workflow runs and their agents, background shells, monitors and MCP servers, as a band above the prompt and a /savvy dashboard of agent cards, each with an animated pixel critter, its effort, model, context, estimated cost and time.

autoOpenPane.title: Auto-open the dashboard
autoOpenPane.description: Open the savvy-progress pane by itself when a workflow or two helpers start (in a fullscreen terminal or the desktop app, once a session).

liveModelPhase.title: Live model phase
liveModelPhase.description: Follow each model request as it streams to show thinking, writing and tool phases, the model and token counts per agent.
